entities.name: murder of Nicole van den Hurk
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: 15-year-old Nicole van den Hurk disappeared on 6 October 1995 in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. Her body was found in the woods between Mierlo and Lierop on 22 November.
